column5: the helper itself: a Clone of http.DefaultTransport with Proxy set to nil on the next line; every production client takes its transport from here

the acr-mcp sidecar runs on the customer's machine and reaches the hosted acr-api through the customer's proxy on purpose, a documented product feature: ACR_API_PROXY_URL, else HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY/NO_PROXY (docs/mcp-sidecar.md "ACR_API_PROXY_URL" and "Proxy Issues", docs/examples/mcp-clients/proxy-and-custom-ca.md); a plain-http loopback or allowed internal API URL gets no proxy; redirects are refused
an explicit proxy from configuration (Config.ProxyURL), never one from the environment: the transport is outboundhttp.Transport() and only a configured ProxyURL replaces its nil Proxy
